description: Play your Mermaid diagrams as elegant, navigable animations.
capabilities.untrusted: In untrusted workspaces diagrams can be viewed and exported, but sidecar files are never written.
command.openToSide: Open Animated Preview to the Side
config.theme.mode: Colour palette of the animator. `auto` follows the editor theme (Ivory for light, Graphite for dark, high contrast for high-contrast themes).
config.theme.mode.highContrast: Always use the high-contrast palette matching the editor theme.
config.codeLens.enabled: Show *▶ Animate · Export…* above Mermaid diagrams in Markdown.
config.files.languages: Language identifiers scanned for Mermaid diagrams.
config.liveReload.enabled: Re-render the animation as you edit the diagram.
config.liveReload.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds after the last edit before the animation updates.
config.sync.stepToEditor: Highlight the current step's statement in the source editor.
config.sync.cursorToStep: Send the editor cursor to the animator (`click`: on mouse clicks, `follow`: on every move). Used to keep your place when editing.
config.sync.cursorToStep.click: Send the cursor when you click in the diagram's source.
config.sync.cursorToStep.follow: Send every cursor move inside the diagram's source.
config.playback.autoplay: Start playing when a panel opens.
config.playback.dwell: How long each step rests before the next one plays.
config.playback.dwell.adaptive: Reading time based on the length of the label and caption.
config.playback.dwellMs: Rest time in milliseconds when `playback.dwell` is `fixed`.
config.playback.onEnd: What happens when autoplay reaches the last step.
config.playback.onEnd.rewind: Return to the beginning and stop.
config.playback.reverse.animate: Play the step backwards at double speed.
config.playback.pauseOnHover: Pause autoplay while the pointer is over the diagram.
config.playback.startAt: Where playback starts when a panel opens.
config.playback.notes: How notes take part in playback.
config.playback.notes.step: Each note is its own step.
config.playback.notes.attach: Notes appear with the preceding step.
config.scrubber.snap: Snap to the nearest step when you release the scrubber.
config.display.futureSteps: How steps that have not played yet are shown.
config.display.pastSteps: How steps that have played are shown.
config.display.pastSteps.trail: Fading with age over the last steps.
config.display.trailLength: Number of recent steps in the trail.
config.motion.profile: Character of the animation. `formal` uses decelerating curves without overshoot.
config.motion.respectReducedMotion: Use minimal motion when the editor or the operating system asks for reduced motion.
config.motion.travelIndicator: Indicator that travels along each message as it is drawn.
config.motion.travelIndicator.comet: A pulse with a short tail.
config.camera.mode: How the camera behaves during playback.
config.camera.mode.auto: Fit small diagrams; follow large ones.
config.camera.mode.follow: Keep the current step in view.
config.camera.mode.cinematic: Frame each step tightly, gliding between steps.
config.playback.loopIterations: How many times loops play when `@iterations` is not given.
config.playback.compressRepeats: Play loop repetitions after the first at double speed.
config.playback.altBranches: Which branches of `alt` and `critical` fragments play (`@branch` and the inspector override it).
config.playback.altBranches.ask: Stop and ask which branch to play.
config.playback.parallel: How the lanes of `par` fragments play.
config.playback.parallel.concurrent: Together: the k-th step of every lane at once.
config.display.showCaptions: Show the caption strip for steps with `@caption`.
config.display.showInspector: Show the inspector beside the diagram on wide panels (toggle with `D`).
config.presentation.chapterCards: Introduce each chapter with a card during presentations.
config.presentation.zenMode: Also enter Zen Mode when a presentation starts.
config.annotations.highlight: Highlight `%% @…` directive names in the editor.
config.view.default: The view a panel opens in (`%% @animator view=` overrides it).
config.view.default.sequence: Participants in columns, messages in order.
config.view.default.topology: Participants as a map of who talks to whom.
config.view.default.split: Both views side by side on one timeline.
config.topology.layout: How the topology view places its nodes.
config.topology.layout.layered: Layers in first-call order (computed off the main thread).
config.topology.layout.force: A force-directed map, identical every time for the same diagram.
config.topology.layout.manual: Drag nodes; positions are remembered per diagram.
config.topology.direction: Direction of the layered topology layout.
config.topology.returnMessages: How return messages (dashed arrows) appear in the topology view.
config.topology.returnMessages.merge: As a dashed lane beside their request edge.
config.topology.edgeWeight: Whether edge width grows with the number of messages.
config.topology.edgeWeight.count: Wider for more messages (up to 5 px).
config.display.showMinimap: When to show the minimap in the corner of the canvas.
config.display.showMinimap.auto: Only while the drawing is larger than the view.
